content.title: Jay-Z's Yankee Stadium Concerts Will Celebrate 'Reasonable Doubt' & 'The Blueprint'
content.text: Skip to ContentNewsJay-Z Announces 2026 Yankee Stadium ShowsBy Chris DeVille5:08 PM EDT on March 18, 2026Share on FacebookShare on RedditShare on EmailShare on Bluesky5CommentsJay-Z's really getting out there in 2026. That gig will be dubbed JAŸ-Z 30. The next night, July 11, he'll be back onstage at the same venue to commemorate the 25th anniversary of The Blueprint. They're calling that one JAŸ-Z 25. No ticket info has been released yet, but Roc Nation's Instagram post announcing the concerts concludes with instructions to "stay tuned."Jay has been making moves to promote the Reasonable Doubt anniversary in recent weeks. He had his name changed to JAŸ-Z on streaming services in a nod to the formatting he used circa Reasonable Doubt and released the original version of that album's lead single "Dead Presidents" on streaming.
